host: Shared AMD Ryzen 7 5800X 8-Core Processor, Linux 7.2.4-arch1-2. Not an isolated capacity test.
sourceNotes: environment.commit records HEAD at run start; benchmark and production edits were still uncommitted during early measurements. It is not a claim that the benchmark existed at that commit.
rust.json uses protocol-shaped serde_json::Value fixtures. boundaries.json and guard-encoding.json use the actual typed ServerMessage serializer and production compact encoder.
Valid memory measurements predate per-case browser context isolation. Final IndexedDB measurements use fresh contexts and assert empty actual engine databases before every trial.
Earlier IndexedDB timings with incorrect namespace cleanup were discarded. No such timing is delivered.
The main browser bundle predates cc004a7d membership batching. after-storage.json includes that change with the same fixtures and wire settings.

Some native builds overlapped early memory trials. Cold snapshot trials overlapped the storage-after run. IndexedDB variability is large; do not infer universal speedups or rank codecs by the noisy durable cases.
IndexedDB API commits in isolated contexts are measured, not physical persistent-profile disk flush or crash durability.
Native PMD browser decompression is included in latency. Browser decodeUs does not separately observe native inflation.
Snapshot samples are limited to three durable or eight memory observations. Raw p95/p99 fields for those samples are not reliable tail estimates.
SQL, permissions, SDK dispatch, digest verification, auth/reconnect handshakes, TLS and WAN are excluded. Expired cursor is encoded as full-resnapshot fallback only.

Raw browser files record repeated run hashes. Original pre-resume bundle hash: 861bd965dceab11d56863235176fa56d032400ef7bdc5e2cbcc150d074673688; original matrix binary hash: 5418684584148e1fcde5e1aa8753cc4b502b1eb697fc21dac8f5fc182fae7818.
